name: @tfl5/sdk
description: JavaScript/TypeScript client for the Tafalo (tfl5) app platform: apps, resources and docs, access control, files, site publishing, realtime, auth and billing.

scripts.test: npm run build && node test/subscribe-smoke.mjs && node test/subscribe-multikey-smoke.mjs && node test/subscribe-multiresource-smoke.mjs
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2021 --minify --keep-names --outfile=dist/browser/sdk.mjs && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=__tfl5sdk --target=es2021 --minify --keep-names --footer:js="if(typeof window!=='undefined'){window.TFL5=__tfl5sdk.TFL5;window.tfl5sdk=__tfl5sdk;}" --outfile=dist/browser/sdk.js && esbuild src/ui.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2021 --minify --keep-names --outfile=dist/browser/sdk-ui.mjs && esbuild src/ui.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=tfl5ui --target=es2021 --minify --keep-names --outfile=dist/browser/sdk-ui.js
